description: This file defines utility functions for PDF document creation and a helper class for associating metadata with test PDF documents within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: DocTag
classes.description: Represents metadata for a PDF document, such as its title, used for testing purposes.

classes.name: PdfDocUtility
classes.description: Provides static helper methods related to PDF document creation.

methods.name: CreateNewPdfDocument
methods.description: Creates and configures a new PDF document with optional title and predefined properties for testing.
